findings.claim: Both smine-orchestrate wrapper call sites (routines/smine-nightly/run.sh:325-336 and cmd/bootstrap/run.sh:163-171) run the merge on the real main checkout with no rollback — the postcondition only detects a dirty tree after the fact and never runs git merge --abort or resets, so an agent killed mid-merge (budget exhausted, bootout, crash) leaves the checkout half-merged and the next nightly run starts from that broken tree.
findings.fix: Either wrap the merge in the wrapper so it can git merge --abort on a nonzero orchestrate exit before reporting, or add to the skill's hard invariants that on any failure inside step 2 it must git merge --abort before writing .orchestrate-report, as a wrapper-independent obligation.

findings.claim: The hook unconditionally denies any Write/Edit to acdsl/registry.local.json in gated mode, so an agent using Write/Edit can never exercise a local_overrides escape hatch that policy.json sanctions and that the authoritative overlayViolations gate accepts, even though the path remains reachable via Bash and acdsl check.
findings.fix: Add a follow-up note in the README's Modes section if the intent is that the hook only blocks the tool-mediated path (this matches the plan's own hook listing, so it is a plan-level rough edge rather than an implementer deviation).

findings.claim: installEnvValues does not strip inline trailing comments from a KEY=value # comment line (only a whole-line leading # is recognized), so a hand-annotated install.env would silently include the comment in the value.

handleReposDelete never revokes the additionalDirectories grant that handleReposAdd makes (explicitly deferred in the plan's own Deferred findings, not a finding against this diff), and the surface grows since casual installs now always grant, accumulating ungranted-on-delete entries over time.
